mistakenly.linePrev: And now you're lit up by the city
mistakenly.lineNext: In the window of the tallest tower
stanza: In the window of the tallest tower
Calling passers-by but much too high
To see the empty road at happy hour
Gleam and resonate, just like the gates
With words like "Lost and found" and "Don't look down"

partner.line: Gleam and resonate, just like the gates
